results.title: Environmental actions as a form of social prescribing for young people: needs, f
results.reason: The paper proposes Environmental-action Social Prescribing (ESP) as a clinical intervention model for young people's mental health, directly addressing climate-related distress through structured environmental action pathways, which has clear clinical utility for mental health practitioners.
results.authors: Caroline X. Gao; Rebecca Patrick; Samantha Julia Legaspi Eala; Sunny N Nguyen; David Baker; Angela H. Gold; Judah Njoroge; Georgia Monaghan; Courtney Kovac; Alison Hill
